description: Named OpenStreetMap features tagged office=lawyer in the Netherlands, derived from the EU-POIS/NL quadkey-tiled POI export (zoom 12). Named features only; filtered to the European Netherlands bounding box (lat 50.7-53.62, lon 3.3-7.25) to exclude cross-border tile bleed; deduplicated on (name, coordinates rounded to ~100 m); coordinates to 6 dp (WGS84); sorted by name. The source ships only name and coordinates - no administrative attribute - so no province or gemeente split is possible without inference, and none was made. Native Dutch names preserved (ensure_ascii=False).
